findings.note: Senate Bill 1174 (2024), voter identification: says local governments cannot set their own voter ID rules for local elections. Vote list taken from the Internet Archive copy of the leginfo vote page. Assembly floor vote, 57 to 16; the roll lists her as Megan Dahle.

findings.motion: AB 1116 Do pass as amended (Senate Appropriations)
findings.note: Assembly Bill 1116 (2025), voter registration: lets a person with no driver license or state ID register online using the last four digits of a Social Security number, and sets up an electronic signature image for ballot matching. Senate Appropriations Committee do-pass-as-amended vote, 5 to 2.

Assembly Bill 1116 (2025), voter registration: lets a person with no driver license or state ID register online using the last four digits of a Social Security number, and sets up an electronic signature image for ballot matching. Senate floor vote on the Assembly bill; Digital Democracy records her as a no vote. Digital Democracy later shows the bill vetoed on 2026-09-27.
